content: Sosep oh Rie kan
Eri, Seikop ahpw usehlahte eh keikeiru nan Kenan, wasa me eh pahpao kin kousoan ie mahs.

Eri, iet duwen poadopoad en eh peneinei. Sosep, pwutak pwulopwul men me mahkiher sounpar eisek isuh oh kin iang rie ko, nein Pila oh Silpa en eh pahpao eh pekehi ko, apwahpwalih nair pelin sihpw oh pelin kuht kan. E ahpw kedipairailda rehn ar pahpao duwen mehkot sapwung me re wiahda.
Sosep inenen soisoi pahn Seikop sang rie teiko koaros, pwehki eh ipwidi ni eh pahpao eh ohl laudlahr. Seikop eri wiahiong Sosep eh likou reirei me kaselel oh peh reirei.
Ni rie ko ar tehkada duwen ar pahpao e kesempwaliki kowahlap Sosep sang irail koaros, re kailongkihla mehlel, oh solahr men lokaia mwahu ong.
Kedekedeo, Sosep ahpw wiahda ouraman ehu, e ahpw koasoiaiong rie ko duwe. Met ahpw kahrehiong ar inenen kailongkihla.
E ndaiong irail, “Kumwail rong mahs duwen me I ouramandahro.
Dene kitail koaros mihmi nansapw piripirepene kapakap en pilawa kei; a iet ei kapakapo pa kesihnenda, a amwail ko kapilpene ahio oh poaridi mwowe.”
Rie ko ahpw idek reh, “Ke lemeleme me ke pahn wiahla at nanmwarki, de ke pahn kaunkitada?” Ar kailongki ahpw ukla mehlel, pwehki eh ouramano.
Sosep pil pwurehng ouraman, oh ndaiong rie ko, “I pil pwurehng ouraman oh kilangada duwen ketipin, maram, oh usu eisek ehu ar poaridi mwohi.”
E ahpw pil ndaiong eh pahpao duwen ouramano, eh pahpao eri lupwoarehda, ndaiong, “Ia duwe? Pwehki omw ouraman, ke lemeleme me omw nohno, riomw kan, oh pil ngehi, se pahn poaridi mwohmw?”
Rien Sosep ko ahpw kin peipeiriniong, a eh pahpao ahpw kin medemedewe irair wet.
Sosep Netla Rehn mehn Isip kei
Rien Sosep ko eri kohla likin Sekem pwe re en sinsile nein ar pahpao pelin mahn kei.
Seikop eri ndaiong Sosep, “I men ke en kohla Sekem, wasa me riomw ko kin apwahpwalih pelinmen ko.” Sosep ahpw sapeng, “Iet ngehi, I onopadahr.”
Eh pahpao eri ndahng, “Eri, kohwei oh kilang ia iren riomw ko, oh ia iren mahn akan. Ke ahpw pwurodo oh pakairkihong ie.” Semeo eri kadarala Sosep sang nan Wahun Epron. Ni Sosep eh lel Sekem,
ohl emen ahpw tuhwong ni eh kohkohseli nansapw, e ahpw idek reh, “Dahme ke raparapahki?”
Sosep ahpw sapeng, “I raparapahki riei ko. Ia wasa re kin apwahpwalih ie nait pelinmen ko?”
Ohlo ahpw nda, “Re apwtehn mweselsang met. I mwur rong ar ndinda me re pahn kohla Dodan.” Sosep eri douluhlla raparapahki rie ko, e ahpw diarihrada Dodan.
Rie ko eri kilangada eh kohkohdo dohsang irail, oh mwohn eh kerendohng irail re inoukihda re en kemehla.
Re ndapene nanpwungarail, “Ien sounouramano, e kohkohdo.
Nna, kitail kemehla oh kesehdiong nan ehu pwareren. Kitail nek nda me mahn lawalo me kangala. Kitail ahpw pahn kilang da katepen eh ouraman kan.”
Reupen rongada arail koasoio, e ahpw song en kapitasang Sosep rehrail. Ih eri ndahng irail, “Kitail dehr kakerehdi nta.
Kumwail dehr kemehla. Kumwail kesehdiongete nan ehu pwareren nan sapwtehnet, ieremen kauwehla paliwere.” E ndaiong irail met pwe e men kapitasang Sosep rehrail oh kapwurelahng rehn eh pahpao.
Ni Sosep eh lel rehn rie ko, re kapwuhrasang eh likou reireio;
oh koledi kesehdiong nan pwoahr madekeng ehu.
Nindokon ar mwengemwenge, re kilenglahte kilangada mehn Ismael kei me seiseiloaksang Kilead. Neirail kamel kan wa diren kepwe kesempwal kei, me re weuwa kolahng Isip.
Suda eri ndaiong rie ko, “Dah katepehiong kitail, ma kitail kemehla riatailo oh ekihla eh mehla?
Kitail netikihla rehn mehn Ismael pwukat, oh dehr wiahiong paliwere mehkot suwed; pwe ih pil riatail, kisehn udukatail oh ntahtail.” Rie ko eri pwungkihda.
Eri, ni sounnet en Midian kei ar keid wasao, pirieno ahpw apihadahsang Sosep nan pwoahro oh netikihong mehn Ismael ko ni mwohni silper 20. Mehn Ismael ko eri walahng Sosep Isip.
Ni Reupen eh pwuralahng ni pwoahro oh diarada me Sosep solahr mi loale, e tehrasang eh likou ko uwen eh nsensuwedla.
Ih eri pwurala rehn rie ko, oh ndahng irail, “Pwutako solahr mi wasao! Dahme I pahn wia?”
Irail eri kemehla kuht men, re ahpw ale en Sosep eh likou reireio oh kaduhdi nan ntahn kuhto.
Re ahpw walahng ar pahpao, nda, “Se diar likou wet. Kilang ma kaidehn en noumw pwutako?”
Seikop kadehdehte me iei, e ahpw nda, “En nei pwutako eh likowo met! Mahn lawalo me kemehla; mahn kommwad me kangala.”
Seikop eri tehrpeseng eh likou ko oh pwuhriong nan likoun nsensuwed. E ahpw mwahieiki nah pwutako rahn tohtohie.

Nah pwutak ko oh nah serepein koaros ahpw kin pokondohng reh, pwe re en kansenamwahwihala. Ahpw e sohte men nsenamwahula, e kin ndindahte, “I pahn mwahmwahieiki nei pwutako, I lao pahn kohdihla reh nan sousou.” Ih eri usehlahte mwahmwahieiki nah pwutak Sosep.
Ni ahnsowo, mehn Midian ko netikihla Sosep rehn Podipar nan Isip, emen sapwellimen Parao lapalap ako, me kaunen pwihnen silasil en tehnpaso.
